name: EVision V2 keyboards
description: Per-key colours for EVision keyboards with the V2 firmware protocol, in the keyboard's direct mode, adapted from OpenRGB: the BYGG CSB ICL01 320F:5041 (plugin.js) and the Endorfy Omnis 3299:0012 (endorfy-omnis.js, its own module because of its vendor id). Untested. Nothing is written to the keyboards' profiles or stored colours. Older EVision keyboards (OpenRGB's first EVision controller, 0C45:5004 ... 320F:5084, including 320F:5064) are not driven: OpenRGB's only per-key path for them rewrites the keyboard's stored custom colours on every update. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/evision-keyboard.md.
